text:
sam: quick idea: 'safety-snapshot' before any config rollout. tiny live sample + snapshot of metrics.
rita: how tiny?
omar: 0.1-0.5% for 20-60s, default 0.2%.
sam: router will tag preview requests with X-Preview and route to same path but mark as preview so quotas/billing ignored.
rita: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/{id}/snapshot-run {sample_pct,duration_secs,dedupe_key,metrics}-> snapshot_id. GET /v1/snapshots/{id}/summary
omar: compute delta vs 15m baseline, return safety_score + top regressions. auto-fail if safety_score < 0.9.
ci-bot: note: snapshot-run prototype build passed staging tests: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/snapshot/22
sam: UX: compact modal shows score, small diff chart, apply-rollout CTA. include audit entry with snapshot_id, operator, patch_hash.
rita: add hard cap sample_pct <= 0.5% unless approved. also add budget guard per-org to avoid cost surprises.
omar: need cache bypass header X-Preview-TTL=0 to avoid skewed results from cached responses.
sam: good call. I'll draft RFC and API contract. tagging @rita @omar for infra + metrics.
ci-bot: reminder: staging canary will be torn down 03:00 UTC.
